description: Club founding and changes, replayed by reduceClub (lib/protocol/club-state.ts).
format: Events are signed (BIP-340, zero aux randomness) with keys derived as sha256('blueline-vector:' + name). Expected outcomes are written by hand from docs/protocol.

cases.name: invite-join
cases.description: A closed club (founding and invite encrypted to the club key). Two people join with the invite's proof.

cases.name: replayed-invite
cases.description: Mallory copies Alice's proof into her own join: worthless for another key. Alice's join arrives twice and counts once.

cases.name: invite-race
cases.description: Single-use invites: the earlier join (created_at, then id) takes the place, the other is refused. Dave and Erin join the second invite in the same second; the lower event id wins.

cases.name: expired-and-revoked-invite
cases.description: A join after the invite's expiry, and one after the invite was ended.

cases.name: over-capacity
cases.description: A club for two: the third valid join is refused.

cases.name: roles
cases.description: Who may do what: the owner appoints an admin, the admin appoints a director and removes a member; a director may not invite, a member may not give roles, an admin may not appoint admins or remove the owner.

cases.name: requests
cases.description: Joining without an invite waits for the leadership: Dave is accepted, Carol declined; accepting a gone request and asking twice are refused.

cases.name: role-conflict
cases.description: Owner and admin change Alice's role from the same base. The later one is a visible conflict; the admin resolves it on the new base.

cases.name: owner-transfer
cases.description: Ownership changes only by offer and acceptance of the offered member. Afterwards the former owner is an admin and loses owner rights.

cases.name: leave-and-rejoin
cases.description: The owner cannot leave; a member leaves once. A removed member cannot come back with an invite made before the removal, but can with a new one.

cases.name: key-rotation
cases.description: Only the owner rotates the club key, one epoch at a time.

cases.name: season-rules
cases.description: Season rules are versioned: free changes before the start, after it only with a visible reason, one version at a time, none after the end.

cases.name: unknown-version-and-time
cases.description: A change in a newer format version is kept, not executed. A record dated more than 15 minutes ahead of the reader's clock and one dated before the founding are refused.

cases.name: reader-without-club-key
cases.description: A public club read by an outsider: invites are always encrypted, so a join with an invite waits like a request until the leadership accepts it.
